source_policy: 18 new M5 heads, each on its own inner fitting/stopping patients. All three branches fitted only to current inner fitting embeddings; no validation or external images enter this confirmation.
selection_policy: No bandwidth, ridge, branch weight or architecture search on these new folds. Direct candidate is fixed before any new-fold training.
confirmation_gate: Fixed direct kernel must improve mean six-fold Macro-F1 and have paired patient Macro-F1 CI lower bound>0 against BOTH M5 and the previously development-confirmed coarse Gaussian recipe. Otherwise retain existing frozen models.
uncertainty: Resample patient split groups jointly across images, repeats and paired predictions; confidence intervals do not include all fitting or previous selection uncertainty.
external_test_policy: No external scores, predictions or raw images. Passing confirmation only permits later frozen-inference review, not automatic external evaluation.
